conversation.user: new here — how does a checkout actually flow through this system?
conversation.plan: Nothing indexed yet — I'll build the graph across the repos, find the checkout action, then trace it.

result: platform-core  charge_endpoint → billing.charge → authorize · ledger.record · audit.write · db

conversation.answer: One checkout crosses 3 languages and 2 services — a single traced path.

conversation.user: can any user-supplied input reach a dangerous sink?
conversation.plan: I'll list the risky external calls, see what invokes the worst one, then trace its public endpoint.

actions.call: run_cypher("MATCH (f:Function) WHERE f.resolved = false AND f.name IN ['eval','exec','system','run'] RETURN f.qualified_name")

conversation.answer: Yes — the public POST /api/promotions endpoint reaches builtins.eval via apply_promo. A promo code from the UI runs as code in platform-core. RCE.

conversation.user: fix it — and confirm nothing reaches eval anymore
conversation.plan: I'll replace the eval with a fixed lookup at the sink, commit, then re-run the same trace.
conversation.answer: Fixed. The graph re-synced itself on commit — the promotions path now reaches only billing.charge. eval is gone.
